Stingless Bees: In late 2025 and 2026, select Amazonian municipalities in Peru (such as Satipo and Nauta) made history by granting native stingless bees legal rights as subjects with the right to exist and thrive

Long-horned beetle. The Girdling Behavior: The adult female beetle uses her powerful mandibles to chew a precise, circular groove entirely around a living tree branch. This process—known as "girdling"—effectively cuts off the flow of nutrients and sap. We actually saw branches cut off by this beetle
